verdict.rationale: Windmill's docs and README confirm scripts/functions can be composed together into flows (windmill-gh-1, windmill-docs-2) and workflows-as-code lets you call functions/loops within flows (windmill-docs-5), implying reusable modules, but there is no explicit documentation shown for one flow invoking another flow as a sub-workflow/module across multiple parent workflows. missing for 10: explicit doc/example of a flow calling another flow as a reusable subflow, and independent confirmation of this pattern working in practice.
